diagnosis.what_happened: SEM paths required residual covariance specifications and proper diagram formatting to prevent overlapping elements.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Missing covariance statements caused model misfit, and standard plot dimensions caused visual crowding of latent constructs.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Include theoretical residual covariances and apply horizontal canvas stretch to SEM plots.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Multidimensional scales sharing item variance require explicit residual covariances for model accuracy. Proper visualization requires adequate canvas breathing room.

desired_behavior: Explicitly support and specify residual error covariances (e.g., Ru_Ref ~~ Ru_Dep) in R lavaan for multidimensional scales. Enforce horizontal canvas semPaths generation (e.g., width=4500-4800, height=2400 at 300 DPI) per PTR-20260923-D83E86.
generalization: In SEM, model shared theoretical variance using explicit residual covariances in lavaan. Visually present SEM diagrams using horizontal aspect ratios to ensure spatial legibility.

evidence.observed_value: Clean plot generation and convergent SEM modeling
evidence.threshold_value: No overlapping nodes, robust model identification
